summary: Analyzes what a routing protocol needs to do in industrial plants that use low-power, lossy wireless networks of field devices such as sensors and actuators. It lists functional requirements around reliability, latency, and security. It is an informational requirements document, not a protocol.

eli5.summary: Imagine a factory full of tiny wireless sensors that sometimes lose their messages. This document lists what a postal system for them must be able to do so important notes still arrive safely and on time.

questions: what are the routing requirements for industrial lossy networks
what is roll routing for low-power networks
